scenarios.name: Move the drawing browser between side docks

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is active in the MCAD Software
the drawing browser is docked on the left
the user drags the drawing browser header to the right edge of the workspace
the drawing browser docks on the right
its drawing resources and sheet tree remain visible
the drawing sheet remains visible to its left
the user drags the drawing browser header to the left edge of the workspace
the drawing browser docks on the left
the drawing sheet remains visible to its right
